name: aethercoo-docker-build
description: Build and push AetherCOO backend Docker image to ECR

source.buildspec:
version: 0.2
phases:
  pre_build:
    commands:
      - aws ecr get-login-password --region us-east-1 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin 724413959665.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  build:
    commands:
      - docker build -t aethercoo .
      - docker tag aethercoo:latest 724413959665.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/aethercoo:latest
  post_build:
    commands:
      - docker push 724413959665.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/aethercoo:latest
      - echo IMAGE_PUSHED
